purpose: A medium local behavior-regression layer that joins existing live agent evals, static high-impact specifications, candidate provenance, and D-drive evidence without a daemon or second agent platform.

profiles.capability: One fresh Codex app-server capability canary.
profiles.smoke: One fresh parent-frame admission case plus one Codex app-server capability canary; retired routing golds remain excluded.
profiles.core: Generic parent-frame and mature-owner admission plus capability, nine parent-grounded external-reality cases, nine recursive-frame reconstitution cases, nine natural user-surface cases, proactive mature-first, frozen mature-candidate recall, one real thin-localization trajectory, eight cross-domain productive-action trajectories, and static validation.
profiles.deep: Core plus one current open-world public-repository search.
profiles.intent: Sixty-seven generic fresh Codex parent-frame, source-aware utterance-relation, comparison-dimension, environment-runtime attribution and repair, semantic-scope-fidelity, stable-behavior-delivery, credential-consumer, Windows process-visibility, bounded-transition, default-owner, first-principles, mature-owner, role-separated S control-tower, and cold-native standing exception admission cases without retired domain routing.
profiles.external: Nine parent-grounded external-reality cases covering open expansion, held-out surfaces, local classification reversal, narrow lookup, supplied-material verdict, unknown evidence, marginal stop, and explicit Stop.
profiles.reconstitution: Nine fresh cases covering current-action self-binding, whole-world-before-question, XINAO as the primary neural-computation object, conditional situated self-model, unallocated second-Sol cognition, rigor at the claim boundary, bounded-operation negatives, and explicit Stop.
profiles.surface: Nine fresh natural-language user-surface cases covering continuous silence, status-request metamorphosis, real blockers, explicit receipts, true completion, and non-handback action transfers that may be silent or state a concise immediate route.
profiles.proactive: All six mature-first live cases; routing facts are checked by their real engineering consumers, not the retired context suite.
profiles.reuse: Only the four live open-world-reuse cases plus their deterministic contract validation.
profiles.productivity: Eight disposable-workspace trajectories that test evidence-delta reuse, action/non-action symmetry, classification reversal, necessary rigor, complete reference-behavior alignment, and decision-relevant process visibility.
profiles.subagent: One fail-closed disposable native-Codex-subagent effect-owner/worker/consumer capability probe; not part of core or deep.
profiles.context: Four deterministic context-runtime contract cases by default; live app-server and hook-sink evidence is a separate explicit mode, and contract success never permits a runtime behavior claim.

runtime_claim_requires: fresh read-only Codex app-server trace
direct natural user-visible output rather than a structured route label
paired same-event cases whose current human act changes message authority
no user-placement or hidden engineering-receipt leakage
separate action-trajectory evidence before claiming that a silent action transfer actually executed
fresh read-only Codex app-server trace
balanced open-world, bounded-operation, and Stop cases
natural longitudinal behavior for any stability claim
ordered consumer and state-changing effect trace
classification reversal under changed evidence reach plus changed-domain rigor
read, wait, stop, and rollback as consumer-grounded control choices
user-visible purpose and route, material finding when present, and final effect evidence
complete working-kernel alignment with configuration, health, and worker consensus kept as supporting evidence only
spawn identity in the parent raw trace
completed child terminal for that same identity
later nonce-bearing Owner consumer invocation
explicit -ContextEvidenceMode live
real Codex app-server initialize, thread start or resume, turn start, and compact events
real installed-hook discovery and ordered hook-sink evidence
isolated S and B account homes and context stores
raw model and tool events supporting every behavioral assertion

real app-server trace for every runtime claim
independent review for material global changes
